Strategy: Narrow the sweet band to residuals between thirty-two and forty-two while keeping the mid penalty, testing whether a tighter target works better. This sharpens the preference for a specific leftover size, but the narrower band may trigger too rarely to matter.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 32 and r - item <= 42 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
